tooltip.title: Treatment of Neutrophilic Scarring Alopecias (FD, DC)
tooltip.markdown: Therapy is focused on reducing the bacterial component and controlling the intense neutrophilic inflammation.

tooltip.title: First-Line Treatment Approach
tooltip.markdown: Aimed at targeting both infection and inflammation.

tooltip.title: Systemic Antibiotics
tooltip.markdown:
-   **Tetracyclines (Doxycycline):** Often used long-term for anti-inflammatory effects.
-   **Rifampin + Clindamycin:** A potent combination used for 10-12 weeks to induce remission in Folliculitis Decalvans.

tooltip.title: Therapies for Refractory Disease
tooltip.markdown: For cases that do not respond to antibiotic combinations.

tooltip.title: Isotretinoin (Accutane)
tooltip.markdown: Can be effective, particularly for Dissecting Cellulitis.

tooltip.title: Biologic Agents (TNF-alpha inhibitors)
tooltip.markdown: Agents like Adalimumab or Infliximab are reserved for severe, recalcitrant cases of Dissecting Cellulitis or Folliculitis Decalvans.
